html:
Greetings, Agents!

 

CM Fragment here, bringing you one of the most anticipated updates of the year!

 

[MARVEL’S Avengers: Endgame] has arrived in MARVEL Future Fight!

Thanos and the Avengers are ready for one heck of a showdown!

We've added a lot of changes on this patch, new in-game content and changes in battle to name a few.

Both Thanos and the Avengers have been preparing for the final battle. In light of this, we've added 18 new [MARVEL’S Avengers: Endgame] and [Team Suit] themed uniforms. Make Nebula and Hawkeye grow even further as they can now realize their Potential!

 

Thanos, now demonstrating his immense power against the Avengers! The Mad Titan can now awaken his Tier-3 upgrade!


An all-new World Event mode where Agents can compete together, added new growth content, And a new Agent Level mechanic has been added.

 

Get benefits for uniforms like never before, such as transferring Options and receiving discounts through the Uniform Synergy system!

 

And again, do not forget to celebrate the release of MARVEL’s Avengers: Endgame which is the theme of our April Update!

 

Other game improvements, enhancements, and other game fixes have also been added.

 

▣ 18 New Uniforms have been Added!

 

The Avengers have taken their time to prepare for their fight against Thanos! Combining the power of survival and victory! It is now the time to take the fight to a whole new level.

 

18 new [MARVEL’s Avengers: Endgame] and [Team Suit] themed uniforms have been added.  

 

 

 

 

 

* The Skill descriptions shown above are at Skill Level 1.

* 18 new uniforms will be on sale during the event period. You can check them out on the Marvel Universe menu and by going to the Uniform Room.

* During the New Uniform Sale period, the prices of the uniforms with Synergy Effects will also be discounted.

※Ant-Man’s [MARVEL’s Avengers: Endgame] and [Team Suit] Uniform will have a special discount that’s only available for a limited time. 4/24 After the Maintenance, the uniform will be available for a special price of 750 Crystals, and will be available until 5/7 2:59 PM (UTC+0) | 7:59 AM (PDT).

 

▣ Uniform Synergy System has been added!

 

The ‘Synergy Uniform’ system has been added to help you enhance your uniforms more efficiently. 
Synergy Uniforms consists of 2 specific uniforms that share their Uniform Options, Uniform Rank, and more.
 
Synergy Uniforms share Uniform Rank, Uniform Options, and Uniform EXP with their other Synergy Uniforms. 

 

 

 

- Bonus Option will be applied to Synergy Uniforms if both are owned.

 

If you already own the uniform, you can purchase the Synergy Uniform for 40% off the normal price. 

 

- There will be a 40% Uniform discount for uniforms that has synergy bonuses. 
- During the New Uniform Sale period, the prices of the uniforms with Synergy Effects will also be discounted.

 

* Uniform Synergy System is available for the following uniforms: 

 

 

▣ 2 More Characters Can Now Realize Their Potential!

 

This April update will allow you to realize the potential of the characters below. Nebula and Hawkeye. You can now raise them up to Level 70.

 

 

▣ New Tier-3 Upgrade!

 

The supervillain Thanos is on the move again, and this time, his new powers have gone beyond our imagination!

 

 

 

▣ New Legendary Battle: [Avengers: Endgame]

 

Enter the shoes of our heroes in the MARVEL Cinematic Universe and take part in the storyline of [Avengers: Endgame].
 
The Legendary Battle consists of 3 stages. You get a chance to play as the featured character on each stage, and earn better rewards depending on the rank of the specified character and uniform.

 

 

As a mainstay in our Legendary Battle series, you can get a 6★ Character for free!
Get a 6★ War Machine by playing [The Big Guns], second stage of Legendary Battle - Avengers: Endgame!

 

- Available only if War Machine is below 6★ or if you do not own War Machine.

 

The Legendary Battle: Avengers: Endgame has two levels of difficulty, Normal Mode and Extreme Mode. 


Extreme Mode has a higher difficulty compared to Normal Mode, but you get more rewards!
If you clear the stages in Extreme Mode by fulfilling certain requirements, you can get special rewards.

▣ An All-new World Event Mode Added

 

We have prepared a special event where all Agents can compete! Prepare yourselves for battle. 

 

Remember, World Events are only open during certain times, so make sure to take advantage whenever it is available. 

 

- Remember that you can only get rewards on 2 out of 4 attempts!

 

[World Event Guide Link]

 

Please refer to our World Event guide for more details.

 

In World Event mode, all agents will fight using the same team and the same characters. 

 

- Team and characters will be selected randomly when starting a battle in World Event. 

 

In order to participate in our World Event mode, you have to apply for each entry. Remember that you can only participate in World Event mode for a limited number of times daily, and you can freely enter the mode until the end of the current World Event. 

 

-  You have to apply for participation in the event before you can play the mode. the entry count will reset every 3:00 PM (UTC+0) | 8:00 AM (PDT).

 

- Every Agent will have the same Tiers and Rank, equipped Uniforms, Custom Gear, Comic Cards and etc on this mode.

 

In this event, various types of enemies will appear. You score points whenever you take down the enemy.

 

 

- If your characters get damaged from interception skills or boss attack, a number of points will be deducted from your team. 

 

You will be able to see the rewards, your best record, and battle ratings for the results of your run at the end of the battle. Compensations are also split between individual record and world record.
 
Individual rewards will be given according to the Agent’s performance. 
World Event rewards will be awarded based on the average points you received during the battle, once the timer ends.

 

- You must reach at least one Battle Rating to earn World Event Rewards.
- World Event rewards will be sent directly to your Inbox.
 

▣ New Growth Contents and Agent Level Added

 

Aside from the existing S.H.I.E.L.D. Level, this new system will allow you to raise your level, independent from your current S.H.I.E.L.D. Level.

As your Agent Level increases, your can obtain a variety of bonus effects.

 

Refer to our guide below for more details. 
 

[Agent Level Guide]

 

You can increase your Agent Level by enhancing your Agent and Hero Badges. 

- Your Hero Badge Level increases each time you upgrade or rank up any of your existing characters. 

 

- In order to enhance Agent Badges, you can enhance them using Character Enhancement items (Uru, Custom Gear, ISO-8) or Agent Kits.

 

 

- In order to raise your Agent Badge level, Agent Tokens will be consumed. You can acquire Agent Tokens by playing our all-new World Event mode. 

You get agent points when your Agent Level rises. Accumulated agent points can be invested into agent bonuses. The bonuses will apply to all characters. 

 

 

- You have control on which bonuses you want to prioritize. 

- You can reset the bonuses you have activated, but this will consume Gold. 

 

▣ Other Game Improvements

 

1. [Hero’s Journey] has been removed and will be replaced with an improved tutorial mode called [S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy].
 

 

- You can view tutorials any time you wish, even if you've already cleared them. 

 

* For Agents who were on the existing Hero’s Journey, all remaining missions will be cleared and rewards paid in bulk via the Inbox.
* Agents who have completed the Hero’s Journey can still participate in the new tutorial missions and earn rewards.
 

2. Once you've completed Floor 30 of Shadowland, you can now see this on the main lobby screen as "completed", and you can now see which floor you currently are from 30 onwards. 

 

 

 

3. Frost Beast from Alliance Battle: Extreme mode has been rebalanced. 
- Frost Beast roars at certain periods of time and will get damage received reduction for a limited time.

 

 

4. You can now purchase more uniforms using gold. More uniforms added!

 

 

5. Characters listed below will have their Rank-up, Mastery, Gear Enhancement, and materials being consumed for Tier-2 will be reduced by 50%. 

 

 

6. You can now request for Tier-2 Materials via Alliance Support.

 

 

▣ Other Game Fixes

 

1. An issue regarding Human Torch’s Supernova skill, where his HP recovery skill is applied in an abnormal way. 
2. End of support for devices with iOS versions lower than 7.x.
* If you're running iOS 7.x and earlier, please update your iOS version to continue playing the game.

[This fix will be added on a later time. Added 4/23 4:00 PM (PDT) | 11:00 PM (UTC+0)] 
3.War Machine [MARVEL’s Avengers: Infinity War]’s Machine Gun passive that is activated by the uniform’s effect will no longer work if War Machine has been frozen or petrified. 
4. War Machine [MARVEL’s Avengers: Infinity War]’s Skill: [Minigun Barrage] cooldown has now been modified. The cooldown time of the skill now starts upon usage of the skill. 

 

* All screenshots are taken on a test server and may differ from actual update contents.

 

Thank you.
